approval_scope: User approved the symmetric selection protocol referenced in C03_PAIRED_PILOT_FREEZE_REVIEW_V3.md. No authorization to train, change repository, inspect new test outcomes, or run full campaign.
single_changed_factor: Availability of held-out family validation observations/features/labels/scores to the selector: K in blind versus same K plus U in visible

common_fit.parameter_source: Exact seed-123 historical candidate aggregate, not handwritten parameter approximations
common_fit.preprocessor: Historical full train-part stream, one shared fit. Unsupervised exposure to held-out family training features is explicitly retained and disclosed.
common_fit.stage1_supervised_train: Training cap filtered to exclude all Botnet attack rows; benign retained
common_fit.test_population: Identical ordered complete test partition for both selector arms
common_fit.fit_count: Fit each distinct candidate model exactly once; shared scores; no arm-specific refit

candidate_selection.objective_primary: Stage2 represented-family macroF1 on identical K known-attack validation subset
candidate_selection.tie_secondary: Stage1 AUROC computed over arm's accessible validation view, with heldout Botnet counted as attack in visible arm

stage1_threshold.algorithm: Historical family-aware selector, identical code version both arms

rejector_selection.budget_scope: K-known-only validation rows in BOTH selector arms
rejector_selection.objective: Maximize fixed 7-class composed-system macroF1 on accessible arm validation rows, counting absent class F1 as 0
rejector_selection.global_candidates: All distinct finite uncertainty values on gated accessible validation + no-rejection point. Equal uncertainty ties never split. Reject if score >= threshold.
rejector_selection.family_conditional_reference: Empirical family conditional true-known-family score quantiles using K represented-family labels in both arms
ties: Canonical parameters: higher global threshold or smaller family alpha
rejector_selection.none_feasible: Categorical outcome; never impute fallback or test score

inference_boundary: One pilot holdout/seed establishes software feasibility and fixed-case conditional descriptive pairing only. Not source-independent generalization or causal population treatment effect.
sealing_and_access: Seal both arm decisions and hashes before any test scores or outcomes are accessible to selector; new test evaluation follows seal
remaining_gates: Freeze input full-file content hashes and processed feature-schema digest
Candidate-parameter code binding to historical aggregate
Historical Stage1 threshold selector integrated and tested both views
